name: Remove background
license: Apache-2.0 (Meta's SAM 2.1; module code by Deepshot Studio)
author: Gnomalab Estudio
description: Isolates the subject with SAM 2.1 and replaces the background with black, white or the blurred photo itself. The subject is picked automatically (the nearest thing in the depth map) or with a point you mark. It needs the «SAM 2.1 Small» model (0.2 GB, Apache 2.0), downloaded once and used locally.

params.name: background
params.label: Background
params.tooltip: What replaces the background: 0 = black, 1 = white, 2 = the blurred photo itself.

params.name: blur
params.label: Blur
params.tooltip: How much the background is blurred when «Background» is 2, as a % of the long side of the image.

params.name: feather
params.label: Soften edge
params.tooltip: Softens the outline of the subject, as a % of the long side of the image. 0 = hard edge.

params.name: extent
params.label: Extent
params.tooltip: What counts as the subject when the point is ambiguous: 0 = only the part under the point (a shirt), 0.5 = the object (the person), 1 = the whole (the person and what they touch).

params.name: point_x
params.label: Subject X
params.tooltip: Horizontal position (0 = left, 1 = right) of a point on the subject. -1 = pick automatically, by depth.

params.name: point_y
params.label: Subject Y
params.tooltip: Vertical position (0 = top, 1 = bottom) of a point on the subject. -1 = pick automatically, by depth.
